heroSub: The Cardiology Interest Group is a student-led society for everyone drawn to the heart and circulation. We teach, we run research and clinical exposure, and we build open cardiovascular learning resources for the whole student body.
missionStatement: CIG exists to make cardiovascular medicine accessible, rigorous and exciting for students — connecting classroom physiology to the clinic, the catheterisation laboratory and the research bench.
visionStatement: A student community that produces the next generation of cardiovascular physicians and scientists: clinically curious, research-literate, and confident enough to lead.
whoWeAre: We are a student-led interest group for anyone drawn to the heart and circulation — from first-year students meeting the cardiac cycle for the first time to senior students preparing for a cardiology career. We run teaching sessions, journal clubs, skills workshops, research mentorship and clinical exposure activities, and we build open educational resources like the interactive anatomy and disease modules on this platform.

joinCta.title: Join the Cardiology Interest Group
joinCta.body: Membership is open to students across the Faculty of Medicine, whatever year you are in and whatever you eventually specialise in. Come to a session, bring a question, and see whether cardiology is for you.
joinCta.note: Membership details, intake dates and the application route are placeholders until CIG supplies them.

learningHub.name: CIG Cardiovascular Learning Hub
learningHub.lede: The Learning Hub is CIG's open education programme, built and maintained by the Education Team: an interactive 3D cardiovascular model, disease modules with animated pathophysiology, referenced key-point topics and a cardiovascular glossary — free for every student.
learningHub.blurb: CIG's open cardiovascular education programme: interactive anatomy, disease modules, animated pathophysiology, key points and a glossary.

mission.title: Education
mission.text: High-quality peer teaching in cardiovascular anatomy, physiology, pathology and pharmacology — built around how students actually learn, not around lecture slides.

mission.title: Research
mission.text: Introducing students to cardiovascular research: reading a paper critically, designing a question, handling data, and taking work through to presentation and publication.

mission.title: Clinical Exposure
mission.text: Structured exposure to cardiology in practice — ward rounds, echocardiography, ECG interpretation, catheterisation laboratory observation and cardiac surgery sessions.

mission.title: Collaboration
mission.text: Connecting students with clinicians, researchers and each other, across years and across institutions, so that no one has to find cardiology on their own.

mission.title: Leadership
mission.text: Real responsibility for students: running teams, designing events, mentoring juniors and representing the group — the skills a clinical career quietly demands.

mission.title: Innovation
mission.text: Building better ways to learn cardiovascular medicine, from interactive 3D anatomy to open teaching resources the whole student body can use.

activities.title: Teaching sessions & workshops
activities.text: Regular peer-led sessions on cardiac anatomy, the cardiac cycle, haemodynamics, ECG interpretation and heart sounds, pitched at the year group in the room.

activities.title: Journal club
activities.text: Critical appraisal of landmark and current cardiovascular literature, with a focus on how to read a trial rather than how to memorise its result.

activities.title: Research mentorship
activities.text: Pairing students with faculty and senior students to develop a question, obtain approvals, collect data and present it.

activities.title: Clinical skills
activities.text: Cardiovascular examination practice, ECG reading drills, basic and advanced life support, and simulation sessions.

activities.title: Clinical exposure
activities.text: Observation opportunities in cardiology clinics, echocardiography, the catheterisation laboratory and cardiothoracic theatre.

activities.title: Community & outreach
activities.text: Cardiovascular risk awareness, CPR training for the public, and student-led health promotion in the wider community.

disclaimer.title: Educational use only
disclaimer.body: The information on this platform is provided for the education of students and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. It does not describe the care of any individual patient. Always seek the guidance of a qualified health professional with any questions about a medical condition, and rely on current clinical guidelines and your own institution's protocols for clinical decisions.
